observations.quarter: Whole body framed: open separate front housings, rails, slots, pierced mounts and formed U readable. Clean dark paint proposal; long gray specular bands are studio response, not exposed metal measured from a photo.
observations.reverse-quarter: Underside, return wall, additional asymmetric tab and real rear slots readable. Shadows remain active; no dummy through-pivot tube. Installed side/angle and exact dimensions unconfirmed.
observations.weld-detail: Native macro exposes continuous original bead and rounded return; fine estimated coating visible, no former bright triangular planar fans established. Bead pitch/section are estimates, not factory weld measurements.
observations.return-detail: Native interior return macro shows uninterrupted curved highlights and the vertical wall. Dark broad coating reflections vary with studio sources. Actual authored wall1.8mm, not a measured part section.
